newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury bank deposits top 100 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury bank deposits top 100 mln stg.

text.p: British supermarket chain J. Sainsbury Plc said deposits at its Sainsbury's Bank joint venture with Bank of Scotland totalled over 100 million stg with over 100,000 customers.
In a statement, Sainsbury said sign-ups for the bank, which opened on February 19, were running at over 10,000 per week.
The bank offers an instant access savings account, a Christmas savings account and two types of credit card.
Sainsbury's Bank intends to launch mortgages and personal loans "shortly," the statement said.
"The number of customers joining Sainsbury's Bank has far exceeded initial targets," said the bank's chief executive Rodger McArthur.
"We're confident of the bank's continued success," he added. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
